football_evidence.question: Can Alabama win at the line of scrimmage?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 0.9 points.
supporting: When Alabama has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Alabama’s offense has allowed a sack on 10.0% of its dropbacks, and Texas A&M’s defense sacks the quarterback on 2.8% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).
When Alabama has the ball (third down): Alabama’s offense converts 34.9% of its third downs, and Texas A&M’s defense allows opponents to convert 29.4% of their third downs (FBS average 39.7%).
In his last two games (Georgia and Tennessee), Russell averaged 5.4 yards per attempt, against 10.7 in his five games before that.
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Texas A&M’s offensive line No. 15 nationally and Alabama’s No. 122.
contradicting: When Alabama has the ball (big plays through the air): Alabama’s offense turns 13.6% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Texas A&M’s defense gives up explosive gains on 12.8% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.3%).

When Alabama has the ball (big plays on the ground): Alabama’s offense turns 10.3% of its runs into explosive gains, and Texas A&M’s defense gives up explosive gains on 5.5% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).

When Texas A&M has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Texas A&M’s offense has allowed a sack on 5.2% of its dropbacks, and Alabama’s defense sacks the quarterback on 9.1% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Alabama has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Alabama’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 14.6% of its runs, and Texas A&M’s defense stops 16.0% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).
quarterbacks: Keelon Russell has completed 129 of 194 passes (66.5%) for 1,746 yards, 9.0 yards per attempt, 12 touchdowns and 4 interceptions in seven games for Alabama, and has been sacked on 21 of 215 dropbacks.
Marcel Reed has completed 112 of 200 passes (56.0%) for 1,272 yards, 6.4 yards per attempt, 7 touchdowns and 6 interceptions in seven games for Texas A&M, and has been sacked on 11 of 211 dropbacks.
Brady Hart has completed 12 of 21 passes (57.1%) for 143 yards, 6.8 yards per attempt, 2 touchdowns and 1 interception in three games for Texas A&M, and has been sacked on 0 of 21 dropbacks.
